order_wins: **GPT Infraprojects** — subsidiary GPT Concrete Products South Africa won a 5-year railway sleeper contract from Transnet Freight Rail worth **ZAR 660 million plus VAT** (~Rs 385 crore) _(~25.7% of mcap)_; subsidiary Alcon Builders is separately L1 on a Rs 134.11 crore bid.
**HEG Advanced Materials** — subsidiary Replus Engitech received Indus Towers orders for lithium-ion battery banks worth **Rs 127.35 crore** including GST, executable by May 2027 _(~2.8% of mcap)_.

**Sathlokhar Synergys E&C Global** — won three industrial construction orders totalling **Rs 117.61 crore** including GST, led by Taiwan's Hong Fu Group footwear plant (Rs 101.19 cr), plus Soken and Kemin _(~11.9% of mcap)_.
**Mayasheel Ventures** — Greater Noida Authority awarded a **Rs 38.23 crore** EPC drain-and-road LOA excluding GST, 12 months _(~47.4% of mcap)_.
**Mayasheel Ventures** — NOIDA awarded a separate **Rs 20.83 crore** EPC LOA to rebuild an expressway drain in Sector 105, 9 months _(~25.8% of mcap)_.
**Highway Infrastructure** — NHAI awarded a **Rs 24.46 crore** 90-day LOA for toll collection at the Velanchettiyur Fee Plaza on NH-7, Tamil Nadu _(~7.8% of mcap)_.
**Signoria Creation** — received garment work orders from Zivore Apparel (LIBAS) worth **Rs 2.85 crore** including tax _(~4.2% of mcap)_.

**Nila Infrastructures** — Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation enlarged the Gulbai Tekra slum project to 910 homes, lifting it by **Rs 6.57 crore** to Rs 105.65 crore, paid wholly in TDR _(~2.5% of mcap)_; a Kajimiya ni Chali amendment swaps land for TDR at unchanged value.

**Concord Enviro Systems** — wholly owned subsidiary Rochem Separation Systems won orders worth **Rs 14.25 crore** from a leading solar PV module maker for water and wastewater treatment systems at a Hyderabad facility _(~2.7% of mcap)_.

**Sterlite Technologies** — a wholly owned subsidiary signed a long-term supply agreement with an unnamed international hyperscale partner for optical connectivity products through December 2030, estimated potential value **~USD 1.2 billion** at prevailing prices; orders are released periodically.

**Current Infraprojects** — received a Letter of Award from BSF (Gujarat Frontier) to install 25 kWp off-grid solar plants at 16 border outposts, with battery rooms, worth **Rs 4.89 crore** over 12 months _(~2.6% of mcap; SME)_.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Spectrum Electrical** — received NSE and BSE listing approval for **13,73,625 shares** allotted on a preferential basis at **Rs 2,002** each, about **Rs 275.00 crore** (our arithmetic).
**Prostarm Info Systems** — received BSE in-principle approval for a preferential issue of up to **28,98,717 warrants** at **Rs 147** each to non-promoters, about **Rs 42.61 crore** (our arithmetic).
**Sindhu Trade Links** — NSE and BSE granted trading approval from 1 October for **30,04,55,030 equity shares** of Re 1 allotted on a preferential basis; the issue price is not in the filing.
equity_allotments: **Grand Foundry** — board approved acquiring **90.82%** of Fusionnet Web Services from SAR Televenture for **Rs 256.84 crore** in redeemable preference shares, plus a preferential issue of shares and warrants totalling **Rs 98.85 crore** (our arithmetic), subject to the 28 October EGM.

**Sharp Chucks and Machines** — board approved, subject to an EGM, a preferential issue of up to **40,00,000 warrants** at Rs 81 to promoters and non-promoters, aggregating **Rs 32.40 crore**, and proposed migrating from NSE Emerge to the Main Board.

**North Eastern Carrying Corporation** — allotted **1,00,00,000 convertible warrants** at Rs 18.51 each to promoter Sunil Kumar Jain on a preferential basis, aggregating approximately **Rs 18.51 crore**.

**Jayaswal Neco Industries Limited** — Jayaswal Neco Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 22439134 warrants pursuant to Preferential Issue at its meeting held on October 01, 2026

**Aaradhya Disposal Industries** — a corrigendum to its 15 October EGM notice restates the **proposed** warrant allottees (43 names), led by promoters Anil and Sunil Maheshwari (58.75 lakh warrants) _(★ PROPOSED allotment to Aarth AIF Growth Fund, 5.04 lakh warrants; Saket Agarwal)_.
**Paisalo Digital** — allotted **2,59,12,548 equity shares** on conversion of 14,000 FCCBs (past conversion), lifting paid-up capital to 94.01 crore shares of Re 1.
m_and_a: **Sar Televenture** — board approved selling its **90.82%** of Fusionnet Web Services to its own listed subsidiary Tikona Communication for **Rs 256.84 crore** in redeemable preference shares, subject to shareholders _(intra-group; ~50.3% of mcap)_.
**Ganesh Consumer Products** — completed selling its Hyderabad wheat-flour unit (312 tonnes/day) to Megacity Flour Mills for **Rs 32.50 crore** _(~5.3% of mcap)_.

**Sahana System** — subsidiary Sahana Defence signed an SPA to acquire **60%** of Siddhanta Machining (precision/defence machining; FY25 turnover Rs 0.85 crore), a related-party deal; value to be set by an independent valuer.

**EFC (I)** — completed acquiring **100% of Ultrafresh Modular Solutions** (modular kitchens and wardrobes; formerly 51% owned by TTK Prestige) by share swap, allotting 19,99,996 shares at Rs 270, **Rs 54.00 crore**, to its shareholders _(~2.1% of mcap)_.
**Indo Borax & Chemicals** — completed the acquisition of a **64.26%** stake in Kronox Lab Sciences and appointed Suresh Kalra as Managing Director & CEO.
**Sheela Foam** — amended its agreement with House of Kieraya to change affirmative-vote matters, turning it from a jointly controlled entity into a subsidiary.
**Polyplex Corporation** — fixed the post-closing consideration for its 51% stake in PDPL at **Rs 73.49 crore**, approving the Rs 11.39 crore balance to the continuing sellers.
**Sudarshan Chemical** — completed buying **15.89%** of step-down unit Sudarshan Colorants India from its own European subsidiaries, an intra-group transfer.
**Gland Pharma** — board approved investing **USD 21 million** in Gland Pharma USA, which will subscribe to **60% of Novelstar Pharma Inc.**, making it a step-down subsidiary.

**Kirloskar Oil Engines** — UAE subsidiary KIME completed the purchase of **100% of Kirloskar Trading SA (PTY)**, Johannesburg, a promoter-group company, for **INR 8.25 crore (ZAR 14.08 million)**, per the filing.

**Unimech Aerospace** — infused **SAR 15.30 million** (about Rs 39.36 crore, per the filing) as its 51% share of the first funding tranche of its Saudi JV with Yusuf Bin Ahmed Kanoo; a second SAR 30 million tranche follows.

**Tata Consultancy Services** — agreed to acquire **100% of BBY Services India LLP** (~450 staff in engineering, data and AI; FY26 turnover Rs 294.53 crore) for **Rs 1 lakh** cash, completion expected in 3-4 weeks.

**Viyash Scientific** — step-down subsidiary Alivira Animal Health (Ireland) completed the acquisition of **100% of BioForLife Italia**, Milan, for base consideration of **EUR 15.0 million** plus the agreed net financial position, EUR 1.976 million deferred.

**Aurobindo Pharma** — step-down subsidiary A1 Biochem Labs allotted equity and CCDs to former promoter Dr Rajendra Gadikota for **Rs 33.80 crore** (our arithmetic: Rs 9.18 + 24.62 crore), giving him **20%** fully diluted.
**Dr. Lal PathLabs** — completed the acquisition of its stake in **SN Genelab** on 1 October, as approved by the board on 24 September; no new terms disclosed.

**EPW India** — completed the acquisition of **100% of Dubai-based Exclusive PC World Computers & Requisites Trading** from its promoter-MD for **AED 4,48,350** cash, a related-party deal; the target's 2025 turnover was AED 42,70,036.
**Remsons Industries** — agreed to sell its **26% stake in JV Aircom Remsons Automotive** to Aircom Group India for **Rs 5.20 lakh** cash, ending the joint venture by 31 October 2026.

**Omaxe** — step-down subsidiary Dinkar Realcon sold its **40%** stake in associate Aquarise Developers to Bhupendra Singh, a director of Omaxe subsidiaries, and his spouse for **Rs 7.84 lakh**, a related-party deal.
**GE Power India** — NCLT Mumbai sanctioned its **scheme of arrangement with JSW Energy** by order dated 1 October 2026; the effective and record dates are yet to be announced.
**Tata Steel** — NCLT Mumbai sanctioned the **amalgamation of wholly owned subsidiary Rujuvalika Investments** into Tata Steel on 1 October 2026; value not disclosed.

**TVS Supply Chain Solutions** — NCLT Bengaluru sanctioned the amalgamation for SPC International, the last of five group transferor companies awaiting approval; the scheme takes effect once both NCLT orders are filed with RoC.

**Amber Enterprises** — NCLT Chandigarh gave remaining authorities two weeks to object to merging wholly owned AmberPR Technoplast into Amber, after the tax department and Official Liquidator raised none; next hearing 23 October.
**Sunteck Realty** — board approved a **demerger scheme** with wholly owned subsidiary Satguru Corporate Services as demerged company and Sunteck as resulting company; value not disclosed.

**Shree Pushkar Chemicals** — NCLT Mumbai allowed **withdrawal of the scheme merging subsidiary Madhya Bharat Phosphate into Kisan Phosphates**, citing commercial reasons, so the merger will not proceed.

**Updater Services** — subsidiary Denave India will **close step-down units Denave Europe and Denave Korea**, which contributed Rs 1.92 crore (0.07%) and Rs 11.55 crore (0.39%) of consolidated turnover; no material impact, per the company.

**Valiant Organics** — received an income-tax rectification order for AY 2015-16, relating to erstwhile Amarjyot Chemical, setting a net **Rs 0.22 crore** payable with no penalty; the company is examining it.
capex_core: **Jayaswal Neco Industries** — reached financial closure with all lenders for the new **1.50 MnTPA** pellet plant at Siltara, Raipur first announced on 25 April, costing **Rs 720 crore** (Rs 540 crore debt) _(~8.0% of mcap)_.
business_updates: **Results season** — 7 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Steel Strips Wheels** — posted its highest-ever monthly net turnover of **Rs 625.81 crore** in September, up **52.4%** YoY from Rs 410.60 crore, with gross turnover Rs 728.78 crore and volumes up 27%.
**Hyundai Motor India** — posted its highest-ever monthly sales of **77,916 units** in September 2026, up **10.8%** YoY, with domestic sales of 57,166 (+10.9%) and exports of 20,750 (+10.4%).
**Coal India** — September supplies rose **12.5% to 61.20 MT** and production 9.18% to 53.50 MT; Q2 supplies grew 12.04% to 186.04 MT, against a full-year supply target of 850 MT.
**JBM Auto** — registered **274 electric buses** in September, a **33%** market share and the highest in India per Vahan, and 892 in April-September (~24% of a 3,771-bus market).
**CSL Finance** — Q2 update: on-book portfolio up ~24% YoY to **~Rs 1,596 crore**, disbursements ~Rs 384 crore against collections ~Rs 321 crore, capital adequacy ~41%.

**Adani Green Energy** — commercially operationalised **481.9 MW** of renewable capacity at Khavda and Mundra and **3,081 MWh** of battery storage at Khavda, taking operational capacity to 20,762.70 MW and BESS to 6,632 MWh.

**Juniper Green Energy** — a subsidiary commissioned **15.5 MW** of wind capacity in its 200 MW firm and dispatchable renewable project, taking group operational capacity to **~2,740 MWp** and ~603 MWh of BESS.

**Acme Solar Holdings** — commissioned Phase III BESS of **53.63 MW / 214.52 MWh** at its Bikaner FDRE project (PPA with SJVN), COD 2 October, taking commissioned storage to 159.58 MW / 638.32 MWh of 300 MW / 1,200 MWh.

**Regaal Resources** — repair and recommissioning of the damaged **10 MW turbine** at its 825 TPD Kishanganj, Bihar plant will take about **5 days** longer than earlier communicated; other operations are unaffected.
**Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels** — opened **Zone Connect by The Park Visakhapatnam**, a **52-key** Beach Road hotel and its second in the city.
**Optimystix Entertainment** — announced **Game Changers**, an owned business-reality format hosted by R. Madhavan, to be produced in Dubai for the Middle East; value not disclosed.
distress_risk: **Rail Vikas Nigam** — East Coast Railway cancelled, without financial repercussions, its Letter of Award for IP-based video surveillance systems on rolling stock.

**Bharat Coking Coal** — the Dhanbad Certificate Officer started recovery proceedings for an alleged **Rs 3,816.83 crore** outstanding on behalf of the Jharkhand government; the company is examining the claim.

**Mangalore Refinery** — Karnataka High Court dismissed the tax department's appeal against a CESTAT order in its favour on denied CENVAT credit (2010-2014) involving **Rs 2,173.77 crore** plus interest and penalty; nil financial implication.

**SEPC** — Madras High Court closed the award holders' execution petitions after a **Rs 149.5 crore** settlement paid by co-debtor JD-1 under a 2015 indemnity, nil outflow for SEPC, releasing **Rs 154 crore** of attached receivables.
**Eureka Forbes** — Uttar Pradesh GST authorities issued a rectification order **cutting the alleged FY23 liability from Rs 273.40 crore to Rs 4.50 crore**; the company will still contest it.

**ICICI Bank** — received a Maharashtra GST show cause notice raising a **Rs 229.14 crore** demand plus interest and penalty on services to customers maintaining minimum balances; it is already litigating similar demands.
**Skipper** — an Odisha GST show cause notice proposes a **Rs 227.53 crore** demand over GSTR-1, 2A and 3B mismatches; the company disputes it entirely.
**SRF** — a CGST Vadodara-II show cause notice alleges ineligible input tax credit for FY23-FY24 of **Rs 266.32 crore** plus interest and penalty; the company calls it untenable and will contest.
**Vedanta Aluminium Metal** — Orissa High Court **dismissed its writ petition** challenging the bauxite linkage policy; the company is reviewing the judgment and its legal options.

**India Power Corporation (DPSC)** — two directors of material subsidiary **IPCL Power vacated office** on 30 September after it failed to hold its AGM on time; the parent itself is in CIRP since May 2026.

**BGR Energy** — in its NCLAT insolvency appeal the suspended director said the **financial creditor's default has been settled**; an operational creditor claiming about **Rs 4.73 crore** sought to intervene.
**Emmvee Photovoltaic** — subsidiary Emmvee Energy received a Karnataka GST show cause notice for FY23 alleging excess input tax credit, proposing **Rs 38.45 crore** including interest and penalty.

**Mahindra Holidays** — received a Maharashtra GST show cause notice demanding **Rs 36.30 crore** for FY23 (tax Rs 19.11 crore, interest Rs 15.27 crore, penalty Rs 1.92 crore); no material impact expected.
**Nuvoco Vistas** — subsidiary NU Vista received an Odisha GST show cause notice proposing a **Rs 24.99 crore** tax demand for FY23 plus interest and 10% penalty; the company calls it miscalculated.

**Yatra Online** — a Maharashtra GST show cause notice for FY23 proposes **Rs 21.36 crore** of tax plus Rs 16.98 crore interest and Rs 1.52 crore penalty; subsidiary Globe All India also received a Karnataka notice.
**Thirumalai Chemicals** — a Tamil Nadu show cause notice for FY24 seeks **Rs 17.31 crore** in tax, interest and penalty over turnover and input-credit discrepancies; insignificant impact expected.

**5paisa Capital** — a CGST Mumbai East notice proposes recovery of **Rs 15.31 crore** of GST for FY23 over excess and ineligible input tax credit, plus interest and penalty; the company sees no merit.
**WeWork India** — received a CGST Mumbai East notice seeking disallowance of **Rs 11.01 crore** of input tax credit for April 2021-March 2023 plus interest and penalty; no material impact expected.

**Advance Agrolife** — received a Rajasthan GST show-cause-cum-demand notice for FY23 over e-way bill and return mismatches, proposing about **Rs 3.23 crore** including interest and penalty; no material impact expected.
**AYM Syntex** — a Maharashtra GST show cause notice for FY23 proposes **Rs 2.32 crore** (tax Rs 1.17 crore, interest Rs 1.00 crore, penalty Rs 0.15 crore) after an audit; the company will reply.
**Dreamfolks** — received a Hyderabad CGST show cause notice for **Rs 1.88 crore** (tax Rs 1.71 crore plus penalty) over FY23 GSTR-3B vs GSTR-2A credit differences.

**Crompton Greaves Consumer** — the Chandigarh appellate GST authority **upheld a Himachal Pradesh demand** with potential impact of **Rs 1.59 crore** including interest and penalty; a further appeal is planned.

**EIH** — the income-tax department levied a **Rs 0.93 crore** penalty for AY 2016-17 on transfer-pricing and Section 40(a)(i) additions. It is protective and may change once appellate relief already granted is given effect.
**Bharat Bijlee** — received an income-tax demand of **Rs 0.58 crore** for AY 2020-21 from an excess earlier refund and interest recomputation; it will pay.
**Mold-Tek Packaging** — received an income-tax demand notice of **Rs 0.36 crore** for AY 2021-22 following a Section 270A order; it denies any violation.
**JSW Dulux** — received a Punjab GST show cause notice disallowing input tax credit for FY23 totalling **Rs 0.12 crore** including interest and penalty.

**ICICI Lombard** — a CGST appellate order partly allowed its appeal, cutting a July 2017-March 2020 Chennai GST demand from **Rs 25.63 lakh to Rs 3.35 lakh** plus interest and a Rs 0.98 lakh penalty; it may appeal further.
**Ramco Systems** — the Philippine tax authority cut its subsidiary's FY23 demand from **PHP 72.40 million to PHP 3 million**, which the subsidiary paid on 30 September, settling the matter.

**Deepak Fertilizers** — received a **SEBI administrative warning** for not disclosing investments in and guarantees to subsidiaries and material income-tax litigations (FY19-FY22); no material impact expected.

**Allied Blenders** — a sole arbitrator ruled **no arbitration agreement exists** with the Canteen Stores Department, ending its claim over debit notes on Officer's Choice Prestige supplies; a jurisdiction ruling only, value not disclosed.

**Gaja Alternative** — Madras High Court recorded a **joint settlement memo** between group award holders and judgment debtors SEPC and Twarit Consultancy, closing the execution petitions; value not disclosed.
credit_rating_changes: **Tinna Rubber** — CARE **upgraded** its long-term bank rating to **CARE BBB; Stable** from BBB-, and short-term to A3+, on facilities of Rs 237.76 crore.
other_notable: **Godawari Power and Ispat** — board approved incorporating wholly owned **Godawari Energy Solutions** in Maharashtra to take EPC and O&M work on battery energy storage, renewable and power projects; investment not disclosed.

**Atul Auto** — invested **Rs 18.34 crore** in a rights issue of wholly owned NBFC Khushbu Auto Finance, which will use the funds to redeem preference shares held by promoters; total investment now Rs 96.15 crore.
**Lupin** — Philippine unit Multicare Pharmaceuticals completed a **buyback of 30,559 shares**, becoming a step-down wholly owned subsidiary from 1 October; value not disclosed.

**Gretex Industries** — allotted **3,09,660 shares** at Rs 236 each to promoter-group Gretex Corporate Services on conversion of the third warrant tranche; the filing shows **Rs 5.48 crore** against the allotment.
**Mahindra Lifespace** — launched residential project **Mahindra Rivenza at Mahalunge, Pune** on 1 October after RERA approval; value not disclosed.
**Finkurve Financial** — CEO **Naveen Kottala resigned** effective 20 October and the board named **Siddharth Purandare CEO** from 13 December.
